title: Multi-task Pairwise Neural Ranking for Hashtag Segmentation
answer_short: Our new dataset includes segmentation for 12,594 unique hashtags and their associated tweets annotated in a multi-step process for higher quality than the previous dataset of 1,108 hashtags.
answer_rationale: The dataset of hashtags is sourced from the Stanford Sentiment Analysis Dataset, specifically curated by the authors to include 12,594 unique English hashtags and their associated tweets, with annotations performed through a multi-step process to ensure higher quality compared to the previous dataset of 1,108 hashtags.
